title: About InfoEducație
intro: Founded in 1994, the competition is dedicated to high-school students interested in creating multidisciplinary software projects. It has four stages: school, local, county, and national. The national stage takes place in Focșani, Vrancea County.

participation.title: Taking part in the competition
participation.projects: At every stage, students present projects they created regardless of their year of study (grades 9–12). Rankings from each stage decide who advances to the next one.
participation.open: The final stage also includes a 24-hour open team challenge. Teams build a project around a given theme, combining product design, programming, and visual design.
participation.talks: Software engineering talks and learning sessions take place throughout the camp.
